name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the continuation aligns with the context of the conversation. It assesses whether the response is pertinent and directly related to the preceding dialogue.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates the ability of the continuation to sustain interest and encourage further interaction. It assesses if the response prompts additional questions or comments.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow and clarity of the continuation. It considers whether the response is understandable and follows a logical sequence without abrupt topic changes.

name: Informative Value
description: Measures the amount of new, useful, or interesting information provided in the continuation. It gauges whether the response adds value to the conversation with facts or insights.

name: Tone Appropriateness
description: Evaluates whether the tone of the continuation matches the tone of the conversation context. It considers whether the response maintains a consistent mood or sentiment.

name: Personalization
description: Assesses the extent to which the continuation reflects personal input or customization based on the context or the participants involved.

name: Grammar and Syntax
description: Measures the correctness of the continuation in terms of grammar, punctuation, and sentence structure. It ensures that the response is linguistically sound.
